spec_match.rationale: Runs the real setHTML/setHTMLUnsafe with and without an explicit javascriptURLs policy over markup covering a/form/button/iframe navigating attributes, exactly the surfaces the spec's sanitize step governs.

interactive.rationale: Editable textarea, method and policy radio groups, and a run button; each run recounts stripped/kept/untouched attributes from the real output DOM and reprints the serialized survivors.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises an editable lab with safe/unsafe × on/off diffing and serialized output; the page delivers precisely that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-API, per-method legacy behavior on pre-157 builds (with an explicit ignored-unknown-member warning), constructor/method exceptions shown verbatim, and an unexpected-strip tripwire for the keep policy.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5169798320357376 and whatwg/html#12898; crumbs reach the full reference list on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's strip/keep behavioral assertions encode the same contract the lab visualises; the shared panel runs on-page.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with --enable-blink-features=SanitizerAPI via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): safe default run stripped 4/4 javascript: attributes with 2 non-js URLs untouched; setHTMLUnsafe kept 4/4 under both explicit policies with the ignored-option warning displayed — the exact legacy behavior; serialized output verified; zero console errors; the fixture img was made loading=lazy after a first pass surfaced detached-image fetches, and the re-run was network-clean; 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the option-respected path needs a 157+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: sanitizer-lab-ran asserts each run; the no-API branch has its own assert; no unhandled rejections (all failures caught and displayed).

design_system.rationale: Tally colors (emerald stripped / rose kept) sit on bg-stone at AA; textarea and result pre use ivory surfaces with text-black.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea, fieldset/legend radio groups with 44px rows, native run button, result output is aria-live=polite, serialized markup is text inside a focusable pre.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read; controls wrap and the result pre scrolls horizontally.

openQuestions.title: Diff the four quadrants on Chrome 157+
openQuestions.detail: On a 157+ build, verify setHTML with javascriptURLs: true keeps the four javascript: attributes (the newly-possible permissive-safe quadrant) and setHTMLUnsafe with false strips them (the newly-possible strict-unsafe quadrant).

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML safely display output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer setHTML; treat sanitized output as context-specific; never re-mount untrusted survivors blindly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The lab never mounts survivors as live page DOM — output is serialized to text in a pre, and the probe hosts stay detached; javascript: links are therefore never clickable.

guidanceConsulted.query: radio group fieldset legend labelled textarea
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group radios in fieldset/legend, label the textarea, keep targets at 44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both radio groups are fieldsets with legends; the textarea has a visible label; all rows are ≥44px.

summary: Product lab: editable markup through real setHTML/setHTMLUnsafe with the javascriptURLs policy toggles, counting and serializing survivors without ever mounting them. Driven on flag-enabled headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): safe-strips/unsafe-keeps legacy behavior verified with the ignored-option warning shown, clean console, network-clean after the lazy-img fix, 0px overflow both classes.
